title: Make shared mailbox directory recovery guidance match alias send and get-or-create operations
outcome: A refusal from the shared directory-snapshot owner gives recovery applicable to the caller's original operation, without describing alias send or get-or-create as only a termal_list_sessions read.
acceptance: Shared snapshot guidance is operation-neutral or list-specific wording is restricted to the list route, preserving original status, error kind, authority and retained operation identity.
Behavioral coverage exercises the refusal from alias send and get-or-create and proves no message append or authority change occurs before target resolution succeeds.
